title: How to become a clinical psychologist

sentences.en: Psychologists, what if you could earn money beyond trading your time for money?
sentences.zh: 心理学家们，如果你们能赚取除了出卖时间换金钱以外的收入，会怎样？

sentences.en: I'm Dr Marianne Trent, clinical psychologist, and I've been developing passive and recurring income streams since 2019.
sentences.zh: 我是临床心理学家Marianne Trent博士，自2019年以来，我一直在开发被动和经常性收入来源。

sentences.en: I have some exciting news.
sentences.zh: 我有一个令人兴奋的消息。

sentences.en: Sophie Foote's One-to-Many program is now open for enrolment.
sentences.zh: Sophie Foote的“一对多”项目现已开放报名。

sentences.en: It's designed to help you turn your expertise into scalable offers like courses, memberships, and digital products.
sentences.zh: 它旨在帮助你将专业知识转化为可扩展的产品，如课程、会员资格和数字产品。

sentences.en: I completed the program myself in 2022 and have since supported two cohorts of psychologists through their journeys too.
sentences.zh: 我自己于2022年完成了该项目，此后也支持了两批心理学家走过他们的旅程。

sentences.en: And if you join through my affiliate link, you'll receive Sophie's bonuses plus my own exclusive support package at no extra coSt.
sentences.zh: 如果你通过我的联盟链接加入，你将获得Sophie的奖励，以及我提供的独家支持套餐，无需额外费用。

sentences.en: That includes six months of WhatsApp support, four group masterminds, masterclasses, personalized guidance, a Fortnum and Mason treat, and a time-limited one-to-one coaching bonus.
sentences.zh: 这包括六个月的WhatsApp支持、四次小组智囊团会议、大师班、个性化指导、一份Fortnum and Mason的礼物，以及限时的一对一辅导奖励。

sentences.en: Enrolment closes on Monday the 16th of November at 10pm.
sentences.zh: 报名将于11月16日星期一晚上10点截止。

sentences.en: Find out more via my bonus page linked in the description.
sentences.zh: 通过描述中链接的我的奖励页面了解更多信息。

sentences.en: And remember, you must purchase through my link to receive my bonuses.
sentences.zh: 请记住，你必须通过我的链接购买才能获得我的奖励。

sentences.en: I'm here if you have any questions.
sentences.zh: 如果你有任何问题，我随时为你解答。

sentences.en: If you're looking to become a psychologist, then let this be your guide.
sentences.zh: 如果你正寻求成为一名心理学家，那么让这成为你的指南吧。

sentences.en: With this podcast at your side, you'll be on your way to the Aspiring Psychologist podcast with Dr. Marianne Trent.
sentences.zh: 有了这个播客在身边，你将走上成为“有抱负的心理学家”播客（由Marianne Trent博士主持）的道路。

sentences.en: Hi, welcome along to the Aspiring Psychologist podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 嗨，欢迎来到“有抱负的心理学家”播客。

sentences.en: I am Dr. Marianne Trent and I'm a qualified clinical psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 我是Marianne Trent博士，我是一名合格的临床心理学家。

sentences.en: I'm a qualified clinical psychologist with a fractured elbow, which was not on the plan, wasn't on the agenda.
sentences.zh: 我是一名合格的临床心理学家，但我的手肘骨折了，这不在计划之内，也不在议程上。

sentences.en: And so this episode is going to be a little bit shorter as yet it's thrown my life slightly into chaos.
sentences.zh: 所以这一集会稍微短一点，因为它让我的生活陷入了轻微的混乱。

sentences.en: So I hope you'll find this quick overview useful about how you go about becoming a clinical psychologist in the UK.
sentences.zh: 所以我希望你会觉得这个关于如何在英国成为临床心理学的简要概述很有用。

sentences.en: That is if you are a UK resident, I will aim to do future content for how you do conversions in future.
sentences.zh: 前提是你是一名英国居民，我以后会争取制作关于如何进行转换课程的内容。

sentences.en: If that is of interest to you, you could listen to an episode I did with Michaela Thomas, which is episode 61 of the Aspiring Psychologist podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 如果你对此感兴趣，可以听听我与Michaela Thomas合作的一集，那是“有抱负的心理学家”播客的第61集。

sentences.en: So I hope you'll find this really useful.
sentences.zh: 所以我希望你会觉得这真的很有用。

sentences.en: We have, of course, got compassionate Q&As you can catch up on.
sentences.zh: 当然，我们有富有同情心的问答环节，你可以回顾一下。

sentences.en: And the next one is coming to you on the 2nd of May.
sentences.zh: 下一场将在5月2日举行。

sentences.en: Watch out on my socials for those.
sentences.zh: 请留意我的社交媒体获取相关信息。

sentences.en: And yeah, all of the replays are easily available from my YouTube, Dr. Marianne Trent.
sentences.zh: 是的，所有的重播都可以从我的YouTube频道“Dr. Marianne Trent”轻松获取。

sentences.en: And if you're watching on YouTube now, please do subscribe and like.
sentences.zh: 如果你现在正在YouTube上观看，请务必订阅并点赞。

sentences.en: Hope you find this useful.
sentences.zh: 希望你觉得这很有用。

sentences.en: If you've got any ideas for future podcast episodes, then please do let me know.
sentences.zh: 如果你对未来的播客节目有任何想法，请务必告诉我。

sentences.en: So whilst I'm waiting for people to join us, I thought I would briefly go through a who I am and be what the process is for becoming a clinical psychologist in the UK.
sentences.zh: 所以，在等待大家加入的同时，我想简要介绍一下我是谁，以及在英国成为临床心理学的过程是什么。

sentences.en: If you're watching on YouTube, why not subscribe?
sentences.zh: 如果你正在YouTube上观看，为什么不订阅呢？

sentences.en: That would be good.
sentences.zh: 那会很棒的。

sentences.en: I will briefly go through what the process is to become a clinical psychologist in the UK.
sentences.zh: 我将简要介绍在英国成为临床心理学的过程。

sentences.en: So it is a three year professional doctorate qualification.
sentences.zh: 这是一个为期三年的专业博士学位资格。

sentences.en: The majority of places are NHS funded at band six level.
sentences.zh: 大多数名额是由英国国家医疗服务体系（NHS）资助的，属于第六级（Band 6）。

sentences.en: But it is also possible on some courses, I think there's maybe three, four, maybe five courses that accept self funding.
sentences.zh: 但有些课程也可能接受自费，我想大概有三、四、五个课程吧。

sentences.en: But that's not done without due consideration because you'd need to pay the expenses, which I think are about 30 grand a year, I think.
sentences.zh: 但这需要经过慎重考虑，因为你需要支付费用，我想每年大约是3万英镑。

sentences.en: And you'd need to also pay your own living expenses to be able to afford food, rent, fuel, all of those things.
sentences.zh: 而且你还需要支付自己的生活费，才能负担得起食物、房租、燃料以及所有这些开销。

sentences.en: So it's not a small amount of money.
sentences.zh: 所以这不是一笔小数目。

sentences.en: Sometimes people's employers ask them to, well, they agree to fund it for them.
sentences.zh: 有时雇主会同意为他们资助。

sentences.en: So that also is a possibility if you're not feeling particularly flush.
sentences.zh: 所以如果你手头不宽裕，这也是一种可能性。

sentences.en: But even then, even if you want to self fund, it's still incredibly competitive to get a place.
sentences.zh: 但即便如此，即使你想自费，获得名额的竞争依然非常激烈。

sentences.en: And they're not going to let you get onto that doctorate if you haven't got the appropriate skills, qualifications and expertise.
sentences.zh: 如果你没有适当的技能、资格和专业知识，他们是不会让你进入博士课程的。

sentences.en: So by the time you have an interview for the doctorate in clinical psychology, whether that is self funded or whether that is taught,
sentences.zh: 所以当你参加临床心理学博士面试时，无论是自费还是公费，

sentences.en: you will have an undergraduate degree, which confers, which offers you the graduate basis for registration with the British Psychological Society.
sentences.zh: 你都将拥有一个本科学位，这赋予了你英国心理学会的注册研究生基础资格。

sentences.en: You may also see that called the GBC graduate basis for certification, I think something like that.
sentences.zh: 你可能还会看到它被称为GBC，研究生认证基础，我想大概是这样。

sentences.en: But it changed a few years ago.
sentences.zh: 但它在几年前改名了。

sentences.en: So you might see it GBC, you might see it GBR and both is fine.
sentences.zh: 所以你可能会看到GBC，也可能会看到GBR，两者都可以。

sentences.en: But yes, that's not enough.
sentences.zh: 但是的，这还不够。

sentences.en: Usually, usually you may have done some additional qualifications.
sentences.zh: 通常，你可能还需要完成一些额外的资格认证。

sentences.en: You may have done a postgraduate certificate.
sentences.zh: 你可能已经完成了研究生证书。

sentences.en: You may have done a master's.
sentences.zh: 你可能已经完成了硕士学位。

sentences.en: Not essential, but always useful to evidence that you're able to strengthen your academic experience.
sentences.zh: 这不是必需的，但总是很有用，可以证明你有能力加强你的学术经验。

sentences.en: You are likely pretty much essentially going to have needed to have done some element of research or dissemination of your abilities,
sentences.zh: 你很可能基本上需要进行某种形式的研究或展示你的能力，

sentences.en: which highlights why you're going to be a brilliant clinical psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 这突显了为什么你会成为一名出色的临床心理学家。

sentences.en: And what else?
sentences.zh: 还有什么呢？

sentences.en: Relevant experience.
sentences.zh: 相关经验。

sentences.en: So I got on to training in 2008 and I graduated in 2002.
sentences.zh: 我是在2008年开始接受培训的，我在2002年毕业。

sentences.en: And it wasn't all pedal to the metal.
sentences.zh: 并不是一直都在全力以赴。

sentences.en: I did do a little bit of backpacking around the world for six months and I saved up to do that.
sentences.zh: 我确实去世界各地背包旅行了六个月，我为此存了钱。

sentences.en: So, yeah, there was a fair amount of sitting in a hammock and drinking lovely cocktails.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，有相当长的一段时间是在吊床上喝着美味的鸡尾酒度过的。

sentences.en: But there was also a lot of hard work across a variety of different clinical populations where I was able to hone my craft.
sentences.zh: 但我也在各种不同的临床人群中进行了大量的艰苦工作，在那里我能够磨练我的技艺。

sentences.en: So that is a little bit about the route.
sentences.zh: 这就是关于这条路线的一点点介绍。

sentences.en: Once you're on the doctorate in clinical psychology, you do that for three years.
sentences.zh: 一旦你进入临床心理学博士课程，你就要学习三年。

sentences.en: You have to pass a variety of clinical placements.
sentences.zh: 你必须通过各种临床实习。

sentences.en: You usually have between five to six, four to six clinical placements.
sentences.zh: 你通常会有五到六个，或者四到六个临床实习。

sentences.en: And you'll do assignments during that time.
sentences.zh: 在此期间你还要完成作业。

sentences.en: And then you need to pass each clinical placement.
sentences.zh: 你需要通过每一次临床实习。

sentences.en: And you also have assignments and a piece of unique research to do, which composes your thesis.
sentences.zh: 你还需要完成作业和一项独特的研究，这构成了你的论文。

sentences.en: It's a lot to balance.
sentences.zh: 这需要平衡的事情很多。

sentences.en: It's a lot to juggle.
sentences.zh: 这需要兼顾的事情很多。

sentences.en: But if you were not aware of that, I hope that's useful.
sentences.zh: 但如果你之前不知道这些，希望这对你有用。

sentences.en: But if you found this helpful, please do consider leaving me a testimonial that I can use on socials or drop me something anonymously.
sentences.zh: 如果你觉得这很有帮助，请考虑给我留下一个评价，我可以在社交媒体上使用，或者匿名发给我。

sentences.en: That's great.
sentences.zh: 那太棒了。

sentences.en: Or on LinkedIn, you can write me a recommendation.
sentences.zh: 或者在LinkedIn上，你可以给我写推荐信。

sentences.en: If we're not already connected on there, I think you might need to send me a connection request to to demonstrate that you think what I've got to say is useful and supportive.
sentences.zh: 如果我们还没有建立联系，我想你需要给我发送一个连接请求，以证明你认为我所说的话是有用和支持性的。

sentences.en: Like I said, the podcast can be really useful, especially the interviews, episodes and the interview prep episodes.
sentences.zh: 就像我说的，播客真的很有用，尤其是访谈节目和面试准备节目。

sentences.en: So 65 is learn and learn and revise better.
sentences.zh: 所以第65集是关于学习和更好地复习。

sentences.en: 64 is preparing for interview success.
sentences.zh: 第64集是关于为面试成功做准备。

sentences.en: Optimally prepare for interviews is episode 10.
sentences.zh: 第10集是关于如何优化面试准备。

sentences.en: There's also other replays that you can watch on my YouTube channel, Dr. Marianne Trent.
sentences.zh: 你也可以在我的YouTube频道“Dr. Marianne Trent”上观看其他重播。

sentences.en: And yeah, if you think you might find it helpful to come aboard to the aspiring psychologist membership, there is no minimum requirement for you to stay.
sentences.zh: 是的，如果你认为加入“有抱负的心理学家”会员计划对你有帮助，你没有最低停留期限要求。

sentences.en: You want to just come for a month and see if it's a good fit for you.
sentences.zh: 如果你只想加入一个月看看是否适合你，

sentences.en: That's absolutely OK, too.
sentences.zh: 那也完全没问题。

sentences.en: There'll be links in my bio for how you can do that.
sentences.zh: 我的个人简介里会有链接，告诉你如何操作。

sentences.en: And like I said, the the clinical psychologist collective and the aspiring psychologist collective make excellent reads as well.
sentences.zh: 就像我说的，“临床心理学家集体”和“有抱负的心理学家集体”也是非常好的读物。

sentences.en: Thank you so much for watching.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢你的观看。

sentences.en: I hope you found that useful.
sentences.zh: 希望你觉得这很有用。

sentences.en: Thank you also for being part of my world and trusting you to bring you what you need to know when you need to know it.
sentences.zh: 也感谢你成为我世界的一部分，并信任我，让我能在你需要的时候为你提供你需要知道的信息。

sentences.en: And if you've got any questions or ideas for future episodes, please do get in touch.
sentences.zh: 如果你有任何问题或对未来节目的想法，请务必与我联系。

sentences.en: I will look forward to catching up with you for the next episode of the podcast, which is available to you from 6 a.m.
sentences.zh: 我期待着在下一集播客中与你相见，该节目将于周一早上6点发布，

sentences.en: on Mondays, by which time I hope my elbow will be a little bit more healed.
sentences.zh: 到那时我希望我的手肘能稍微愈合一点。

sentences.en: Take care and thank you for being part of my world.
sentences.zh: 保重，感谢你成为我世界的一部分。
